Open points for Daniel

  • Crumb: the shell draws it at the start of the main column. Quick create still centres its own content (slice 1b, not built), so the crumb does not line up with the h1 yet.
  • Sidebar from 720 px, as specified. Between 720 and about 1280 px pages lose 240 px while their own breakpoints still measure the window, so wide boards scroll sideways (see the Registration board at 1024 px). Options: keep 720 px and fix pages as they adopt PageFrame, or show the sidebar from 1280 px and use the sheet below that.
  • Below 640 px the search is an icon button and "Back to Classic" reads "Classic", so all controls stay 44 px and readable.
